calculation.expression: 1 / (std(pct_change(close), 60) * sqrt(252) + 0.05), lagged by one completed session
calculation.description: Ranks tradable instruments higher when their trailing 60-session annualized realized volatility is lower, with a stabilizing risk floor. The signal is shifted one session to avoid look-ahead.

validation.regime_notes: 60-session signal passed the benchmark gates (absolute IC >= 0.0070 and absolute ICIR >= 0.0840). 10/20/40-session ICIR values were 0.042771/0.018792/0.076900 and did not pass. 20-session regime ICs: 2024 -0.047542, 2027-2029 +0.060919, 2030 +0.000062, 2031-2032 -0.066110, 2033 YTD +0.011904. Small cross-asset universe uncertainty is material; use as a defensive complement rather than standalone alpha.
